description: One line of the library's change log, version 1, appended to .neo/changes.jsonl when a page comes in (page-imported), a page is updated from a newer source (page-updated), or an image or PDF a page names is copied in (attachment-imported, naming the page that brought it). A page in a NEO book is named by bookId and chId; a page file in wiki/ or sources/ by page, its id. Ripple reads the log.

page.description: A page file's id: its tree, a slash, and its path in the tree, such as sources/Daily/Ebb.html.

dest.description: The page's file (a chapter file, or a page file in wiki/ or sources/), or the attachment, relative to the library, with forward slashes.

src.description: The file it came from, as picked or as found.
